You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke (50 episodes total)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E16: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
E17: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
E18: When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.
E19: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.
E20: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
E21: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
E22: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
E23: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
E24: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
E25: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
Direct lead-in to E26: Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold.

Below are 5 consecutive episodes. For EACH episode, find the best 1 to 3 promo candidates (20-60 s each, hook_line starting in the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the cut near its end, exact hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote from the cited line IDs).

=== EPISODE 26 (duration 120.9 s) ===
LOGLINE: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
CONTINUITY: Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold.
[L001 0.0-5.8] SCREEN: Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.
[L002 0.0-5.5] ACTION: Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
[L003 5.8-10.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.
[L004 6.5-9.0] SFX: Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
[L005 10.5-14.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.
[L006 11.0-14.0] ACTION: The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
[L007 14.2-20.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.
[L008 14.2-20.2] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Raspy): "Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."
[L009 20.5-25.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.
[L010 20.6-25.4] JULIANA (Urgent, Reassuring): "Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."
[L011 25.8-28.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
[L012 25.8-28.4] ACTION: The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
[L013 28.5-30.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
[L014 30.8-35.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.
[L015 30.8-35.5] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Faint, Discerning): "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
[L016 35.8-40.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.
[L017 36.0-39.8] JULIANA (Humble, Sincere): "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
[L018 40.2-43.2] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.
[L019 40.3-43.0] JULIANA (Gentle, Calming): "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."
[L020 43.2-47.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.
[L021 43.5-47.0] JULIANA (Hushed, Tense Whisper): "If the guards hear us, we are both dead."
[L022 47.5-50.8] SCREEN: Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
[L023 50.8-55.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
[L024 52.5-55.5] ACTION: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
[L025 55.8-62.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.
[L026 56.0-62.0] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Heartbroken): "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
[L027 62.5-67.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.
[L028 62.6-66.7] JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast): "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
[L029 67.0-71.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
[L030 71.8-79.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
[L031 73.8-79.4] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Curious, Searching): "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
[L032 79.6-86.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.
[L033 80.0-85.8] JULIANA (Painful, Proud): "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
[L034 86.5-90.8] SCREEN: Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
[L035 87.0-90.5] ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
[L036 90.2-92.0] SFX: A sharp, stunned gasp.
[L037 90.8-95.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
[L038 90.8-95.0] ACTION: The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
[L039 95.0-100.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.
[L040 96.0-99.8] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Breathless, Shaken): "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
[L041 100.0-105.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.
[L042 100.5-105.0] JULIANA (Confused, Alarmed): "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
[L043 105.5-109.0] SCREEN: Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
[L044 106.0-109.0] ACTION: The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
[L045 108.8-110.0] SFX: A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
[L046 109.0-110.8] SCREEN: Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.
[L047 109.2-110.6] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Stern, Desperate): "Do not move!"
[L048 110.8-115.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.
[L049 111.0-115.5] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Intense, Demanding): "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
[L050 115.8-119.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana frozen in shock, her breath catching as the Duchess's desperate words echo in the silence of the room.
[L051 119.5-120.9] SCREEN: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.

=== EPISODE 27 (duration 150.5 s) ===
LOGLINE: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
CONTINUITY: Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin.
[L001 0.0-2.1] SCREEN: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.
[L002 1.3-3.2] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Breathless): "This ring..."
[L003 2.1-5.8] SCREEN: Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.
[L004 3.4-5.8] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Urgent, Demanding): "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"
[L005 5.8-9.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.
[L006 6.4-9.3] JULIANA (Hesitant, Sincere): "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."
[L007 9.4-13.2] SCREEN: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.
[L008 9.7-12.8] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Incredulous, Intense): "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
[L009 13.2-16.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.
[L010 13.4-16.4] JULIANA (Earnest, Defending): "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
[L011 16.8-21.6] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.
[L012 17.2-21.2] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Revelatory): "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
[L013 21.6-26.1] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.
[L014 21.8-25.8] JULIANA (Confused, Gentle): "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."
[L015 26.1-31.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.
[L016 26.6-31.4] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Emotionally Strained, Weeping): "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
[L017 31.8-34.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.
[L018 32.1-34.8] JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless): "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
[L019 34.9-37.4] SCREEN: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.
[L020 35.2-37.6] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging): "My lost son wore that ring!"
[L021 37.4-40.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.
[L022 37.8-40.2] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Pleading): "Did your husband serve beside him?"
[L023 41.0-44.2] JULIANA (Soft, Reverent): "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
[L024 44.2-46.4] SCREEN: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.
[L025 44.5-46.4] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate): "What is your husband's name?"
[L026 46.4-48.3] SFX: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
[L027 46.5-48.8] SCREEN: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
[L028 48.8-51.5] ACTION: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
[L029 48.8-51.5] SCREEN: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
[L030 51.5-55.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.
[L031 52.2-55.6] LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory): "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"
[L032 55.6-58.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.
[L033 56.8-58.4] JULIANA (Calm, Defiant): "She needed help."
[L034 58.6-62.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.
[L035 60.0-61.8] LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious): "What are you hiding?"
[L036 62.0-64.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.
[L037 62.2-63.5] JULIANA (Firm): "Nothing."
[L038 64.0-66.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.
[L039 64.8-66.4] LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh): "Show me your hand."
[L040 66.5-70.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.
[L041 66.6-70.1] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative): "Girl. Show me what you are holding."
[L042 70.5-73.8] SCREEN: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.
[L043 72.6-73.7] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical): "What is this?"
[L044 73.8-74.8] JULIANA (Steady): "Medicine."
[L045 74.8-77.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.
[L046 75.2-77.8] LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending): "Medicine? You are a new maid."
[L047 77.8-80.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.
[L048 78.1-80.5] LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing): "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"
[L049 80.8-83.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.
[L050 81.0-82.0] JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute): "No one."
[L051 83.0-86.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.
[L052 83.6-86.4] LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant): "Then you administered it without permission."
[L053 86.5-88.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.
[L054 86.5-87.8] JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent): "Because she was dying!"
[L055 88.0-92.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.
[L056 88.2-92.4] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating): "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
[L057 92.8-95.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.
[L058 93.3-94.9] JULIANA (Fierce): "The physicians were not saving her!"
[L059 95.0-97.8] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.
[L060 95.3-97.7] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Measured, Menacing): "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
[L061 97.8-103.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.
[L062 98.8-103.4] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening): "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."
[L063 103.6-107.8] SCREEN: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.
[L064 104.2-107.5] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Contemptuous): "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."
[L065 107.8-110.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.
[L066 108.3-109.8] JULIANA (Unyielding): "It is an antidote."
[L067 110.2-112.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.
[L068 110.3-111.8] LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative): "An antidote to what?"
[L069 112.5-113.6] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.
[L070 113.2-114.3] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Stern, Barked): "Answer her."
[L071 113.6-115.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.
[L072 115.0-117.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.
[L073 115.1-116.5] JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute): "Poison."
[L074 117.2-120.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.
[L075 118.7-119.8] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous): "Poison."
[L076 120.0-122.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.
[L077 120.4-122.6] JULIANA (Urgent): "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
[L078 122.8-124.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.
[L079 123.1-124.5] LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror): "You hear that?!"
[L080 124.6-128.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.
[L081 124.8-128.4] LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing): "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
[L082 128.5-131.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.
[L083 128.7-130.8] JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged): "That is not what I said!"
[L084 131.0-134.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.
[L085 131.2-132.6] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy): "Enough."
[L086 134.0-139.4] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.
[L087 134.8-138.5] ACTION: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
[L088 136.2-139.3] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating): "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
[L089 139.4-144.2] SCREEN: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.
[L090 139.6-143.8] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive): "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."
[L091 144.0-144.9] BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern): "Take her."
[L092 144.2-147.5] SCREEN: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.
[L093 145.0-148.0] ACTION: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.
[L094 147.5-149.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.
[L095 149.2-150.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.

=== EPISODE 28 (duration 138.5 s) ===
LOGLINE: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
CONTINUITY: Picks up directly from Episode 27 as Rupert orders the guard to seize Juliana, ignoring the waking Duchess.
[L001 0.0-2.3] SCREEN: Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.
[L002 0.0-2.1] ACTION: Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.
[L003 1.8-3.2] SFX: Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.
[L004 2.3-4.7] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.
[L005 3.2-4.6] ACTION: Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.
[L006 4.7-10.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.
[L007 4.9-6.3] CATHERINE (Mocking, Cruel): "Look at her, Rupert."
[L008 6.6-8.1] CATHERINE (Scoffing): "Soot on her face..."
[L009 8.2-12.6] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.
[L010 8.4-10.0] CATHERINE (Accusing, Smug): "...herbs in her pockets..."
[L011 10.2-12.3] CATHERINE (Cold): "...a secret medicine in her hand."
[L012 12.6-15.2] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.
[L013 12.7-15.0] CATHERINE (Venomous): "She looks exactly like a poisoner."
[L014 15.2-18.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.
[L015 15.3-18.4] JULIANA (Furious, Defiant): "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
[L016 18.5-22.8] SCREEN: Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.
[L017 18.9-20.3] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sardonic, Chilling): "A clever story, girl."
[L018 20.4-22.7] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Threatening): "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
[L019 22.8-26.7] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.
[L020 24.8-26.5] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining): "Rupert..."
[L021 26.7-28.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.
[L022 26.7-28.2] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Commanding): "Stop this!"
[L023 28.4-32.8] SCREEN: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.
[L024 28.8-30.3] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm): "She is innocent."
[L025 30.8-32.4] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant): "She saved me!"
[L026 32.8-34.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.
[L027 33.2-34.6] JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved): "Your Grace..."
[L028 34.9-37.7] SCREEN: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.
[L029 35.0-37.4] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
